blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08 against official Zephyr v2.3.0 source commit 67c5f53b878fef41fb5e74c4382d5b7a2f37fd8a and native-chain HF11 block 837231 (2026-08-08 19:36:16 UTC; hash 9e024c96ef5e31b25daa407c0715a43e74f9fdfc18c258bf4c50077ef15f160d). ZYS is the native Zephyr yield asset, not a production EVM token. Same-asset ZYS sends map to YIELD_TRANSFER, and the reviewed source exposes no separate address-level blacklist, holder freeze, seize, privileged burn, or current issuer transfer-control path. ZYS shares the historical 2025 network-wide audit/hardfork transaction restriction with ZSD; this was a consensus-wide migration rather than a current holder-targeted issuer control. No direct blacklistability established.

oracleRisk.summary: ZYS mint and redemption prices are consensus-derived from the on-chain ZSD yield-reserve tally and ZYS supply. Yield-reserve accrual converts a ZEPH block-reward allocation into ZSD using Zephyr's signed pricing record; three delivery endpoints share one hard-coded RSA signing key, and nodes may reuse the last acceptable record for up to ten blocks.

branchApplicability.rationale: ZYS is a protocol-wide share of the ZSD Yield Reserve, not a borrower debt market. Its share price is derived from the single yield-reserve tally, while ZEPH-denominated yield accrual uses Zephyr's signed pricing record. There are no collateral-specific liquidation branches, so the complete exposure belongs at top level.
